info.name: Match Insights API
info.description: Smoke tests for the deployed Match Insights backend. Set baseUrl to the Render service URL. Provider API keys stay on the server; do not put them in Postman.

exec: pm.test('Pipeline and chat configuration are present', function () { var body = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(body.llm).to.be.an('object'); pm.expect(body.chat).to.be.an('object'); });
pm.test('Connection check endpoint returns HTTP 200', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });

pm.test('Connection check includes a diagnosis', function () { var body = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(body).to.have.property('ok'); pm.expect(body).to.have.property('problem'); pm.expect(body).to.have.property('hint'); });
pm.test('Match endpoint returns HTTP 200', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });
pm.test('Match data contains events and insights', function () { var body = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(body.events).to.be.an('array'); pm.expect(body.insights).to.be.an('array'); });
pm.test('Chat endpoint returns HTTP 200', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });

pm.test('Chat returns an answer and model status', function () { var body = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(body.answer).to.be.a('string').and.not.empty; pm.expect(body.llm).to.be.an('object'); pm.expect(body.llm).to.have.property('state'); });
console.log('Chat source and model status:', { source: pm.response.json().source, llm: pm.response.json().llm });
